records.title: STATUS OF AIIMS, JAMMU AND AWANTIPORA
details:
Further, under Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS) for 'Establishment of new Medical
Colleges attached with existing district/referral hospitals', 7 Medical Colleges, one each
Anantnag, Baramulla, Doda, Kathua, Rajouri, Udhampur and Handwara have been
approved for the UT of Jammu & Kashmir at a total cost of 1,595 Cr. with a fund sharing
mechanism of 90:10. Till date Central Share of ₹ 1.176.50 Cr. has been released
